> (auto generated by Claude)

## Summary

Adds a fused low-latency decode chain for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at TP4 on SM100 (B200/B300), taking each layer's attention sublayer from the query to the MoE input in four PDL-chained kernels:

- `decode_attention`: sparse decode attention over the V4.1 fp8 SWA cache plus the fp8/fp4 indexed cache, inverse RoPE fused into the epilogue, output in FlashMLA MegaAttention's mega-fp8 format (replaces `flash_mla_mega_decode` and its `pack_query`).
- `wo_a_fp8`: the wo_a GEMM on that output with the same `quantize_wo_a` weights `fp8_einsum` uses, emitting the MXFP8 input of wo_b (replaces DeepGEMM `fp8_einsum` + the activation quant). It prefetches its weight before `griddepcontrol.wait`.
- `wo_b_fp8` + `all_reduce_mhc`: wo_b (FlashInfer MXFP8 weight layout, `weight_scale_inv_swizzled`) pushes its rows straight into the CustomAllReduceV2 push plane (unicast or multicast); the consumer drains it with the mHC post, the pre-collapse and the RMSNorm, with the arithmetic of `all_reduce_mhc_post_combine_norm` (replaces wo_b + `all_reduce_mhc_post_combine_norm`).

New pieces:
- Kernels under `kernels/jit/csrc/deepseek_v4/low_latency/`, Python ops under `kernels/ops/attention/dsv4/low_latency/`.
- `include/sgl_kernel/tcgen05.cuh`: tcgen05 wrappers and UMMA descriptors, `TCGen05Common` plus `TCGen05<kCtaGroup>` for cta_group 1/2.
- `srt/models/deepseek_v4_low_latency.py`: `LowLatencyChain`, built once per layer after weight loading when every static precondition holds (SM100, DSv4.1, mega attention, TP4 with attn TP == TP and no attn DP/CP, FlashInfer MXFP8 wo_b, a registered push plane, JIT nvcc >= 13.2); used for decode / target-verify batches of at most 64 tokens, otherwise the existing path runs.
- `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_LOW_LATENCY_DECODE` (default on) to opt out.

## Validation

4x B300 (TP4, DSpark, cookbook low-latency config): sgl-eval GSM8K unchanged vs the existing path; kernel-level correctness checked against the replaced kernels on B200/B300.

+    asm volatile("tcgen05.fence::before_thread_sync;" ::: "memory");

+  /// Shared-memory operand descriptor (addresses and offsets in 16 B units).
+  union SmemDesc {
+    struct {
+      uint64_t start_address : 14;        // [ 0,14)

+      uint64_t : 2;                       // [30,32)
+      uint64_t stride_byte_offset : 14;   // [32,46) stride between MN atoms
+      uint64_t version : 2;               // [46,48) 1 on Blackwell
+      uint64_t : 13;                      // [48,61)
+      uint64_t layout_type : 3;           // [61,64) 0: none, 2: 128 B swizzle
+    };
+    struct {
+      uint32_t lo_bits;
+      uint32_t hi_bits;
+    };
+    uint64_t bits;
+
+    /// The operand window slid by `bytes`: one 32-bit add on the low word, as the 14-bit address field never
+    /// carries (smem < 256 KiB).
+    SGL_DEVICE SmemDesc advance_bytes(uint32_t bytes) const {
+      SmemDesc desc = *this;
+      desc.lo_bits += bytes >> 4;
+      return desc;
+    }
+  };
+  static_assert(sizeof(SmemDesc) == 8);

+    desc.start_address = to_shared(smem) >> 4;
+    desc.stride_byte_offset = sbo_bytes >> 4;
+    desc.version = 1;
+    desc.layout_type = layout_type;
+    return desc;
+  }

+        "tcgen05.alloc.cta_group::%2.sync.aligned.shared::cta.b32 [%0], %1;" ::"r"(to_shared(dst)),
+        "r"(n_cols),
+        "n"(kCtaGroup));
+  }
+  /// Lets the SM's other CTAs allocate: without it a second CTA's alloc never returns.
+  SGL_DEVICE static void relinquish_alloc_permit() {
+    asm volatile("tcgen05.relinquish_alloc_permit.cta_group::%0.sync.aligned;" ::"n"(kCtaGroup));
+  }
+  SGL_DEVICE static void dealloc(uint32_t taddr, uint32_t n_cols) {
+    asm volatile("tcgen05.dealloc.cta_group::%2.sync.aligned.b32 %0, %1;" ::"r"(taddr), "r"(n_cols), "n"(kCtaGroup));
+  }
+
+  // ---- completion ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+  /// Arrives (count 1) on `bar` once every cp / mma this thread issued before it has completed.
+  SGL_DEVICE static void commit(uint64_t* bar) {
+    asm volatile("tcgen05.commit.cta_group::%1.mbarrier::arrive::one.shared::cluster.b64 [%0];" ::"r"(to_shared(bar)),
+                 "n"(kCtaGroup)
+                 : "memory");
+  }
+  /// The same, arriving on `bar` at the same smem offset in every CTA of `cta_mask` (cluster ranks).
+  SGL_DEVICE static void commit_multicast(uint64_t* bar, uint16_t cta_mask) {
+    asm volatile(
+        "tcgen05.commit.cta_group::%2.mbarrier::arrive::one.shared::cluster.multicast::cluster.b64 [%0], %1;" ::"r"(
+            to_shared(bar)),
+        "h"(cta_mask),
+        "n"(kCtaGroup)
+        : "memory");
+  }
+
+  // ---- smem -> TMEM copies (`sdesc`: an SmemDesc of the source) ------------
+
+  SGL_DEVICE static void cp_128x256b(uint32_t taddr, uint64_t sdesc) {
+    asm volatile("tcgen05.cp.cta_group::%2.128x256b [%0], %1;" ::"r"(taddr), "l"(sdesc), "n"(kCtaGroup) : "memory");
+  }
+  SGL_DEVICE static void cp_128x128b(uint32_t taddr, uint64_t sdesc) {
+    asm volatile("tcgen05.cp.cta_group::%2.128x128b [%0], %1;" ::"r"(taddr), "l"(sdesc), "n"(kCtaGroup) : "memory");

+  }

+  SGL_DEVICE static void cp_32x128b_warpx4(uint32_t taddr, uint64_t sdesc) {
+    asm volatile("tcgen05.cp.cta_group::%2.32x128b.warpx4 [%0], %1;" ::"r"(taddr), "l"(sdesc), "n"(kCtaGroup)

+  }
+
+  // ---- block-scaled MMA (kind::mxf8f6f4, UE8M0 scales in TMEM) -------------
+  // D [+]= A x B; accumulate == 0 overwrites D. `idesc` is an MxInstrDesc.

+  /// A from TMEM, B from smem.
+  SGL_DEVICE static void mma_mxf8_ts(

+      uint32_t taddr_a,

+      uint32_t idesc,
+      uint32_t taddr_sfa,
+      uint32_t taddr_sfb,

+        "tcgen05.mma.cta_group::%7.kind::mxf8f6f4.block_scale [%0], [%1], %2, %3, [%4], [%5], p;\n\t}" ::"r"(taddr_d),
+        "r"(taddr_a),
+        "l"(bdesc),
+        "r"(idesc),
+        "r"(taddr_sfa),
+        "r"(taddr_sfb),
+        "r"(accumulate),
+        "n"(kCtaGroup)

+  }
+  /// A and B from smem.
+  SGL_DEVICE static void mma_mxf8_ss(
+      uint32_t taddr_d,
+      uint64_t adesc,
+      uint64_t bdesc,
+      uint32_t idesc,
+      uint32_t taddr_sfa,
+      uint32_t taddr_sfb,
+      uint32_t accumulate) {
+    asm volatile(
+        "{\n\t.reg .pred p;\n\tsetp.ne.b32 p, %6, 0;\n\t"
+        "tcgen05.mma.cta_group::%7.kind::mxf8f6f4.block_scale [%0], %1, %2, %3, [%4], [%5], p;\n\t}" ::"r"(taddr_d),

+        "l"(bdesc),
+        "r"(idesc),
+        "r"(taddr_sfa),
+        "r"(taddr_sfb),
+        "r"(accumulate),
+        "n"(kCtaGroup)

+  }

+"""Fused SM100 DSv4.1 sparse decode attention (CUDA, cluster combine), small batch.
+
+Emits the attention output in FlashMLA MegaAttention's fp8 format, the activation DeepGEMM
+``fp8_einsum`` (wo_a) consumes: ``o_fp8 [B, 2, 4096]`` e4m3 in ``interleave_output_columns``
+order and ``o_s [B, 2, 32]`` int32 packed UE8M0 per-32 scales, stored MN-major
+``[2, 32, ceil4(B)]``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+HEAD_DIM = 512
+NUM_HEADS = 16
+GROUP_HEADS = 8
+SOFTMAX_SCALE = HEAD_DIM**-0.5
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_module() -> Module:
+    return load_jit(
+        "dsv4_decode_attention_sm100",
+        cuda_files=["deepseek_v4/low_latency/decode_attn.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("run", "dsv4_decode_attention_sm100")],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
+    )
+
+
+def alloc_mega_fp8_output(num_tokens: int, device: torch.device):
+    """``(o_fp8, o_s)`` laid out like FlashMLA's ``allocate_scale_factor``."""
+    groups = NUM_HEADS // GROUP_HEADS
+    o_fp8 = torch.empty(
+        (num_tokens, groups, GROUP_HEADS * HEAD_DIM),
+        dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    t_al = (num_tokens + 3) // 4 * 4
+    o_s = torch.empty(
+        (groups, GROUP_HEADS * HEAD_DIM // 128, t_al),
+        dtype=torch.int32,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    return o_fp8, o_s.permute(2, 0, 1)[:num_tokens]
+
+
+def decode_attention(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    kv: torch.Tensor,
+    indices: torch.Tensor,
+    lengths: torch.Tensor,
+    sink: torch.Tensor,
+    extra_kv: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    extra_indices: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    extra_lengths: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    *,
+    inv_rope: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]] = None,
+    out: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Returns ``(o_fp8, o_s)`` (see the module docstring).
+
+    kv is the V4.1 fp8 SWA cache (528 B/token); extra_kv, if any, is V4.1 fp8 or fp4
+    (288 B/token). inv_rope: ``(freqs [rows, >=64] f32 (cos, sin) pairs, positions [B]
+    int32/int64)``, or positions None for a per-row ``[B, >=64]`` buffer; fuses the inverse
+    RoPE of each head's last 64 dims. PDL dependents are released at kernel start, so a
+    weight-streaming successor (wo_a) overlaps the attention. out: optional preallocated
+    ``(o_fp8, o_s)`` of the shapes above, any strides (e.g. a ``[:, :2]`` slice of padded groups).
+    """
+    b = q.shape[0]
+    if q.ndim == 4:
+        assert q.shape[1] == 1
+        q = q[:, 0]
+    if indices.ndim == 3:
+        indices = indices[:, 0]
+    if extra_indices is not None and extra_indices.ndim == 3:
+        extra_indices = extra_indices[:, 0]
+    # [pages, page_size, bytes per token], whatever the cache's head dims
+    kv = kv.view(torch.uint8).flatten(2)
+    if extra_kv is not None:
+        extra_kv = extra_kv.view(torch.uint8).flatten(2)
+    o_fp8, o_s = alloc_mega_fp8_output(b, q.device) if out is None else out
+    freqs, positions = (None, None) if inv_rope is None else inv_rope
+    _jit_module().run(
+        q,
+        kv,
+        indices,
+        lengths,
+        sink,
+        o_fp8,
+        o_s,
+        SOFTMAX_SCALE,
+        extra_kv,
+        extra_indices,
+        extra_lengths,
+        freqs,
+        positions,
+    )
+    return o_fp8, o_s

+"""Low-latency MXFP8 wo_a for DSv4.1 decode on SM100, T <= 64: the GEMM of
+
+    deep_gemm.fp8_einsum("bhr,hdr->bhd", (o_fp8, o_s), (weight, weight_scale), out, recipe=(1, 1, 32))
+
+on the mega-fp8 attention output and the same weight tensors, with its bf16 result act-quantized into the MXFP8 input
+``wo_b_fp8`` takes. See ``deepseek_v4/low_latency/wo_a_fp8.cuh`` for the design. Meant to run as the PDL secondary of
+the attention: the weight streams into smem before griddepcontrol.wait, and it releases its own dependents at start.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+RANK = 1024
+GROUP_K = 4096
+MAX_TOKENS = 64
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _n_tile(num_tokens: int) -> int:
+    for n in (8, 16, 32, 64):
+        if num_tokens <= n:
+            return n
+    raise ValueError(f"wo_a_fp8 supports up to {MAX_TOKENS} tokens, got {num_tokens}")
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_module(n: int) -> Module:
+    return load_jit(
+        f"wo_a_fp8_mxf8_ll_n{n}",
+        cuda_files=["deepseek_v4/low_latency/wo_a_fp8.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("run", f"wo_a_fp8_mxf8_ll<{n}>")],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
+    )
+
+
+def wo_a_fp8(
+    o_fp8: torch.Tensor,
+    o_s: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    out: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """``o_fp8`` [T, G, 4096] e4m3 and ``o_s`` [T, G, 32] int32 (mega-fp8) times ``weight`` [G, 1024, 4096] e4m3 with
+    ``weight_scale`` [G, 1024, 32] int32 (``quantize_wo_a``'s output). Returns (x [T, G * 1024] e4m3, x_scale), x_scale
+    being the UE8M0 per-32 scales of x in FlashInfer's 128x4 swizzled layout (128 * G * 32 bytes)."""
+    num_tokens, groups = o_fp8.shape[:2]
+    if out is None:
+        out = (
+            torch.empty(
+                num_tokens,
+                groups * RANK,
+                dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+                device=o_fp8.device,
+            ),
+            torch.empty(
+                128 * groups * RANK // 32, dtype=torch.uint8, device=o_fp8.device
+            ),
+        )
+    module = _jit_module(_n_tile(num_tokens))
+    module.run(o_fp8, o_s, weight, weight_scale, out[0], out[1])
+    return out

+"""Low-latency FP8 wo_b GEMM for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4 decode (SM100), alone or fused with the TP all-reduce, the
+mHC post-mix, the pre-collapse and the RMSNorm over the CustomAllReduceV2 push plane. See
+``deepseek_v4/low_latency/{wo_b_fp8,all_reduce_mhc}.cuh`` for the design."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce import Communicator
+
+N_OUT = 5120
+K_IN = 2048
+MAX_TOKENS = 64
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _n_tile(num_tokens: int) -> int:
+    """MMA N: the smallest of 8 / 16 / 32 / 64 that holds every token."""
+    for n in (8, 16, 32, 64):
+        if num_tokens <= n:
+            return n
+    raise ValueError(f"wo_b_fp8 supports up to {MAX_TOKENS} tokens, got {num_tokens}")
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_gemm_module(n: int, world_size: int, multicast: bool) -> Module:
+    mc = "true" if multicast else "false"
+    return load_jit(
+        f"dsv41_wo_b_ll_n{n}_w{world_size}_mc{int(multicast)}",
+        cuda_files=["deepseek_v4/low_latency/wo_b_fp8.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("run", f"dsv41_wo_b_ll<{n}, {world_size}, {mc}>")],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
+    )
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_comm_module(world_size: int) -> Module:
+    return load_jit(
+        f"dsv41_all_reduce_mhc_ll_w{world_size}",
+        cuda_files=["deepseek_v4/low_latency/all_reduce_mhc.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("run", f"dsv41_all_reduce_mhc_ll<{world_size}, true>")],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
+    )
+
+
+def prepare_weight(weight: torch.Tensor, block_scale: torch.Tensor):
+    """``(weight, weight_scale)`` as sglang's FlashInfer cute-dsl wo_b keeps them: the plain [5120, 2048] e4m3
+    weight, and its [160, 64] UE8M0 32x32 block scales expanded per row and interleaved by FlashInfer's
+    ``block_scale_interleave`` (the layer's ``weight_scale_inv_swizzled``). For tests; the kernel reads exactly
+    these tensors."""
+    from flashinfer import block_scale_interleave
+
+    assert weight.shape == (N_OUT, K_IN) and weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    assert block_scale.shape == (N_OUT // 32, K_IN // 32)
+    per_row = block_scale.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).repeat_interleave(32, dim=0)
+    return weight, block_scale_interleave(per_row.contiguous()).contiguous().view(-1)
+
+
+def wo_b_fp8(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    x_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``x @ W^T`` in bf16, T <= 64: ``x`` [T, 2048] e4m3 with ``x_scale``, its UE8M0 per-32 scales in FlashInfer's
+    128x4 swizzled layout (``wo_a_fp8``'s output); ``weight`` [5120, 2048] e4m3 and ``weight_scale``, the 128x4 image
+    of its per-row-per-32 scales (the layer's ``weight_scale_inv_swizzled``)."""
+    num_tokens = x.shape[0]
+    n_tile = _n_tile(num_tokens)
+    if out is None:
+        out = x.new_empty((num_tokens, N_OUT), dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    module = _jit_gemm_module(n_tile, 0, False)
+    module.run(x, x_scale.view(-1), weight, weight_scale.view(-1), out, None)
+    return out
+
+
+def wo_b_fp8_all_reduce_mhc(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    x_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    comm: Communicator,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post: torch.Tensor,
+    comb: torch.Tensor,
+    pre: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    *,
+    multicast: bool = True,
+    mhc_out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    normalized: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """``wo_b_fp8`` summed over the TP ranks of ``comm`` (world size 2 / 4), then the HC=4 post-mix with ``residual``
+    [T, 4, 5120] (``post`` [T, 4], ``comb`` [T, 4, 4]), the ``pre`` [T, 4] collapse and RMSNorm(``norm_weight``,
+    ``eps``). Returns (``mhc_out`` [T, 4, 5120], ``normalized`` [T, 5120]), both bf16, the arithmetic of
+    ``all_reduce_mhc_post_combine_norm`` (``normalized`` may differ by a bf16 ulp). ``multicast`` pushes through the
+    plane's multicast address instead of one store per rank.
+
+    Every rank calls with the same T on the same communicator. Both kernels read the plane's phase counters, and the
+    second also ``residual`` / ``post`` / ``comb`` / ``pre`` / ``norm_weight``, before their PDL wait: a kernel that
+    waits before it triggers (the attention) must run between two calls, after the last write of those inputs.
+    Back-to-back calls without one hang."""
+    num_tokens = x.shape[0]
+    n_tile = _n_tile(num_tokens)
+    module = _jit_gemm_module(n_tile, comm.world_size, multicast)
+    module.run(x, x_scale.view(-1), weight, weight_scale.view(-1), None, comm)
+    if mhc_out is None:
+        mhc_out = torch.empty_like(residual)
+    if normalized is None:
+        normalized = residual.new_empty((num_tokens, N_OUT))
+    module = _jit_comm_module(comm.world_size)
+    module.run(comm, residual, post, comb, pre, norm_weight, mhc_out, normalized, eps)
+    return mhc_out, normalized

+"""DeepSeek-V4.1 fused low-latency decode chain (SM100, small batches).
+
+One straight chain takes the attention sublayer from the query to the next
+sublayer's normalized input, replacing the mega attention path's tail:
+
+    decode_attention    V4.1 paged fp8 SWA keys plus the fp8 / fp4 indexed keys,
+                        inverse RoPE folded into the epilogue, emitted in FlashMLA
+                        MegaAttention's fp8 format -- replaces flash_mla_mega_decode
+    wo_a_fp8            that activation x wo_a, emitted as the (e4m3, UE8M0 128x4
+                        image) pair FlashInfer's mm_mxfp8 takes -- replaces
+                        deep_gemm.fp8_einsum plus the activation quant
+    wo_b + all_reduce   wo_b pushing its rows straight into the TP push plane,
+                        drained together with the mHC post, the next combine and
+                        its norm -- replaces wo_b + all_reduce_mhc_post_combine_norm
+
+:meth:`LowLatencyChain.attention` runs the first half in the attention sublayer and
+:meth:`LowLatencyChain.post` the second half in the mHC post, because the post is
+where the mHC coefficients and the next norm live. Nothing else takes a hand: the
+wo_a rows travel between them as the attention's ``mhc.AttnOutput``, where their
+e4m3 dtype says wo_b has not run yet.
+
+Only the token count is dynamic. Every other precondition -- platform, model
+geometry, weight layouts, parallel layout, the registered push plane -- is fixed
+for a layer's lifetime and resolved once by :func:`build_chain` after the weights
+load; a layer whose chain is None never takes this path.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner import get_is_capture_mode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_backend_utils.breakable_cuda_graph.context import (
+    is_in_breakable_cuda_graph,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel, get_platform
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce import Communicator
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+
+# The kernels are built for exactly this geometry; see the static_asserts in
+# csrc/deepseek_v4/low_latency/*.cuh.
+MAX_TOKENS = 64
+NUM_HEADS = 16
+NUM_GROUPS = 2
+O_LORA_RANK = 1024
+HEAD_DIM = 512
+HIDDEN = 5120
+# The push plane world sizes wo_b and all_reduce_mhc are instantiated for.
+WORLD_SIZES = (4,)
+
+# An e4m3 attention contribution is this chain's wo_a rows, with wo_b still to run;
+# everything else is wo_b's bf16 output.
+ROWS_DTYPE = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+
+
+class LowLatencyChain(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """One layer's fused low-latency material, fixed once the weights have loaded.
+
+    ``wo_a_*`` are ``setup_mega_attention``'s quantized wo_a -- the operands
+    DeepGEMM's ``fp8_einsum`` takes -- and ``wo_b_*`` the plain [5120, 2048] e4m3
+    weight with the FlashInfer-swizzled scales its mm_mxfp8 takes.
+    """
+
+    wo_a_weight: torch.Tensor
+    wo_a_scale: torch.Tensor
+    wo_b_weight: torch.Tensor
+    wo_b_scale: torch.Tensor
+    # wo_a's UE8M0 scales, a 128x4 image whose size does not depend on the token
+    # count, so the rows crossing to the post carry their scales implicitly.
+    x_scale: torch.Tensor
+    # The layer's freqs_cis as [max_pos, 64] fp32 interleaved (cos, sin) pairs, the
+    # table the attention's fused inverse RoPE reads (not the mega kernel's
+    # cos | sin halves).
+    rope_table: torch.Tensor
+    comm: Communicator
+    # One multimem store per 16 B instead of one per rank; needs the push plane's
+    # multicast mapping.
+    multicast: bool
+    # The GEMMs' own ceiling, narrowed to what the push plane can stage.
+    max_tokens: int
+
+    def is_active(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch, num_tokens: int) -> bool:
+        """The per-forward half of the gate: the token count the GEMMs and the push
+        plane are built for, on a batch of single-query rows."""
+        mode = forward_batch.forward_mode

+            0 < num_tokens <= self.max_tokens
+            and (mode.is_decode() or mode.is_target_verify())
+            and get_is_capture_mode()

+            # and hands back a fixed bf16 buffer, which this chain does not produce.
+            and not is_in_breakable_cuda_graph()

+
+    def attention(
+        self,
+        *,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_sink: torch.Tensor,
+        forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+        attn_backend,
+        attn_layer,
+        compress_ratio: int,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The sparse decode attention and wo_a; returns the [T, 2048] e4m3 rows
+        whose scales this chain holds in ``x_scale``."""
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsv4.low_latency.wo_a import wo_a_fp8
+
+        data, scale = attn_backend.forward(
+            q=q,
+            k=q,
+            v=q,
+            layer=attn_layer,
+            forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            compress_ratio=compress_ratio,
+            attn_sink=attn_sink,
+            save_kv_cache=False,
+            cos_sin_cache=self.rope_table,
+            low_latency=True,
+        )
+        rows, _ = wo_a_fp8(
+            data,
+            scale,
+            self.wo_a_weight,
+            self.wo_a_scale,
+            out=(
+                torch.empty(
+                    data.shape[0],
+                    NUM_GROUPS * O_LORA_RANK,
+                    dtype=ROWS_DTYPE,
+                    device=data.device,
+                ),
+                self.x_scale,
+            ),
+        )
+        return rows
+
+    def wo_b(self, rows: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """wo_b alone, to bf16 [T, 5120]: for a post with no next norm to fold, which
+        all-reduces the rows itself."""

+
+        return wo_b_fp8(rows, self.x_scale, self.wo_b_weight, self.wo_b_scale)
+
+    def post(
+        self,
+        rows: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        post_mix: torch.Tensor,
+        comb: torch.Tensor,
+        pre: torch.Tensor,
+        norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        eps: float,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """wo_b into the push plane, then the all-reduce, the mHC post, the next
+        combine and its norm; returns ``(mhc_out, normalized)``.
+
+        Both kernels read the plane's phase counters -- and the consumer also the
+        mHC coefficients -- before their PDL wait, so two of these must have a
+        kernel that waits before it triggers between them. The next layer's
+        attention is that kernel; nothing may consume two posts back to back.
+        """
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsv4.low_latency.wo_b import (

+        return wo_b_fp8_all_reduce_mhc(
+            rows,
+            self.x_scale,
+            self.wo_b_weight,
+            self.wo_b_scale,
+            self.comm,
+            residual,
+            post_mix,
+            comb,
+            pre,
+            norm_weight,
+            eps,
+            multicast=self.multicast,
+        )
+
+
+def build_chain(layer, *, fused_mhc_post: bool) -> Optional[LowLatencyChain]:
+    """This attention's chain, or None when any of its fixed preconditions fail.
+
+    Runs after the weights load and after the TP group's push plane is registered

+    no longer changes.
+
+    ``fused_mhc_post`` is the decoder layer's static half of ``defers_sum``: the
+    chain hands the boundary wo_a rows, which only the fused post knows how to
+    finish, so it must not run where the boundary would complete the sum itself.
+    Its dynamic half is the push-plane capacity, which ``max_tokens`` carries.
+
+    The checks below also subsume every term of ``_project_wo_b``'s own deferral
+    predicate (CUDA, attn_tp > 1, and the DP / CP layouts that publish
+    ``mlp_reduce_scatter``), so the caller's gate needs only ``defer_all_reduce``.
+    """
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce_fusion import get_registered_comm
+    from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce_v2 import (
+        CustomAllReduceV2,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.mxfp8_input import accepts_mxfp8_swizzled_input
+
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    if not (
+        envs.SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_LOW_LATENCY_DECODE.get()
+        and fused_mhc_post
+        and get_platform().is_sm100
+        and layer.is_dsv41
+        # The mega attention path owns the V4.1 fp8 KV layout, the fp8 wo_a and the
+        # quantized wo_a operands this chain's wo_a reads.
+        and layer.use_mega_attention
+        and layer.mega_wo_a is not None
+        and layer.alt_streams is not None
+        and accepts_mxfp8_swizzled_input(layer.wq_b)
+        and layer.wq_b.quant_method.mxfp8_dense_backend.is_flashinfer_cutedsl()

+        # layout the attention kernel reads.
+        and not layer.mega_wq_b_permuted

+        and layer.n_local_groups == NUM_GROUPS
+        and layer.o_lora_rank == O_LORA_RANK
+        and layer.head_dim == HEAD_DIM
+        and layer.hidden_size == HIDDEN

+        # be the whole TP group, with no attention DP or CP beside it.
+        and parallel.attn_dp_size == 1
+        and parallel.attn_cp_size == 1
+        and layer.attn_tp_size == parallel.tp_size
+        and layer.attn_tp_size in WORLD_SIZES
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    from sglang.kernels.jit.utils.arch import get_jit_cuda_version
+
+    # The attention kernel's scaled e4m3 -> bf16 conversion (cvt.rn.scaled) needs nvcc >= 13.2.
+    if get_jit_cuda_version() < (13, 2):
+        return None

+    if wo_b_weight is None:
+        return None
+    # The fusion kernels key on world size alone, so this is the same plane
+    # register_fused_all_reduce_comm() handed the MoE finalize.
+    comm = get_registered_comm(layer.attn_tp_size)
+    ca_comm = parallel.tp_group.ca_comm
+    if comm is None or comm.push is None:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(ca_comm, CustomAllReduceV2) or ca_comm.obj is not comm:
+        return None
+    max_tokens = min(
+        MAX_TOKENS,
+        # One phase counter per row, and one slot for the whole [T, 5120] bf16 push.
+        ca_comm.config.num_push_blocks,
+        ca_comm.max_push_size // (HIDDEN * 2),
+    )
+    if max_tokens <= 0:
+        return None
+
+    return LowLatencyChain(
+        wo_a_weight=layer.mega_wo_a[0],
+        wo_a_scale=layer.mega_wo_a[1],
+        wo_b_weight=wo_b_weight,
+        wo_b_scale=wo_b_scale,
+        x_scale=torch.empty(
+            128 * NUM_GROUPS * O_LORA_RANK // 32,
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            device=wo_b_weight.device,
+        ),
+        rope_table=torch.view_as_real(layer.freqs_cis).flatten(1),
+        comm=comm,
+        multicast=ca_comm.has_multicast,
+        max_tokens=max_tokens,
+    )
+
+
+def _flashinfer_mxfp8_wo_b_weights(layer):
+    """wo_b's ``(weight, swizzled scales)`` when it runs the FlashInfer MXFP8 GEMM
+    on the shape the kernel is built for, else ``(None, None)``.
+
+    ``use_flashinfer_mxfp8_wo_b`` is what guarantees ``weight_scale_inv_swizzled``
+    exists: both arms it accepts go through ``_process_mxfp8_linear_weight_scale``.
+    """
+    if not layer.use_flashinfer_mxfp8_wo_b:
+        return None, None
+    weight = layer.wo_b.weight.data
+    if (
+        weight.shape != (HIDDEN, NUM_GROUPS * O_LORA_RANK)
+        or weight.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        or not weight.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        return None, None
+    scale = layer.wo_b.weight_scale_inv_swizzled.data
+    return weight, scale.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).view(-1)
